sections.Profile:
"Hit Line" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Playmatic in 1969. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, and three standup targets.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1969
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Original Theme
